note: First published schema of the detached runner's other files (BG-1), generated from RunnerFileDocument in cli/src/core/runner_store.ts on release/v1.3.0: a client's request in the inbox (start, stop, resume), the runner record, and a job's worker record, worker result and frozen operation spec, each with its own format name and version 1. The files carry their version in the member 'version'; this ledger keys it as schema_version. Nothing was published before it. The readers refuse any other version and any unknown key, so every added, removed or changed member bumps RUNNER_FILE_VERSION.
BG-3: a start request's job `origin` gains the trigger variant (see JOB_VERSIONS.json). Version stays 1 for the same reason.
